modelValue.zh-CN: 当前选中的条目，用 v-model 绑定。传入后即为受控组件，传入 undefined 回到非受控并清空选中项；只在整体替换时识别变化，就地修改受控数组不会生效。单选时是节点或节点路径，多选时可以是路径数组。
modelValue.en-US: The selected entry, bound with v-model. Passing it makes the component controlled, and undefined goes back to uncontrolled and clears the selection. Only a replaced value is noticed, changes made in place to a controlled array are not. In single mode it is a node or a path, in multiple mode it can also be an array of paths.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 指定默认选中的条目，只在挂载时读取。
defaultValue.en-US: The initially selected entry, read once on mount.

multiple.zh-CN: 是否多选。modelValue、defaultValue、change 与 select 的类型随它变化；它没有全局默认值。
multiple.en-US: Whether several paths can be selected. The types of modelValue, defaultValue, change and select follow it; it has no global default.

treeData.zh-CN: 节点数据，label 只接受文本，节点内容用 label 插槽。原地修改响应式数据也会被识别，内容相同的新数组不会重置展开和选中状态。
treeData.en-US: Node data. The label is text only, use the label slot for node content. Changes made in place to reactive data are noticed, and a new array with equal content keeps the expanded and selected state.

keyMaps.zh-CN: 自定义节点中 value、label、children、disabled、isLeaf 的字段名。
keyMaps.en-US: Custom field names for value, label, children, disabled and isLeaf in a node.

changeOnSelect.zh-CN: 单选时是否允许选择非叶子节点。
changeOnSelect.en-US: Whether a non-leaf node can be selected in single mode.

autoMergeValue.zh-CN: 多选时，某个父节点被选中后，值不再包含它的子孙节点。挂载后修改不会生效；与 leafOnly 同时开启时，后者优先。
autoMergeValue.en-US: In multiple mode, the value leaves out the descendants of a selected parent. Changes after mount are not followed; leafOnly takes precedence when both are on.

leafOnly.zh-CN: 多选时，值与展示的标签只包含叶子节点。挂载后修改不会生效。
leafOnly.en-US: In multiple mode, the value and the tags shown only include leaf nodes. Changes after mount are not followed.

checkRelation.zh-CN: 多选时节点之间选中状态的关系：related 为父子联动，unRelated 为互不影响。
checkRelation.en-US: In multiple mode, how the checked states of the nodes relate: related links parents and children, unRelated keeps them independent.

disableStrictly.zh-CN: 是否严格禁用。开启后，禁用的节点不会因父级或子级的选中状态变化而改变。
disableStrictly.en-US: Whether to disable strictly. A disabled node then does not change when its parent or children are checked or unchecked.

max.zh-CN: 多选时选中数量的上限，超出时触发 exceed 事件。
max.en-US: In multiple mode, the most paths that can be selected; exceeding it emits the exceed event.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 多选时标签的最大展示数量，超出的部分以 +N 展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: In multiple mode, the most tags shown; the rest appear as +N.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超出 maxTagCount 后，悬停 +N 时是否用 Popover 展示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Whether hovering +N shows the remaining tags in a Popover once maxTagCount is exceeded.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: 剩余标签 Popover 的配置，可设置 position、trigger 等，参见 Popover。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Configuration of the Popover of the remaining tags, such as position and trigger. See Popover.

enableLeafClick.zh-CN: 多选时，点击叶子节点所在的选项是否触发勾选。
enableLeafClick.en-US: In multiple mode, whether clicking the option of a leaf node checks it.

clickToSelect.zh-CN: 多选时，点击任意节点即触发选中，常与 showNext 为 hover 配合：悬停展开子菜单，点击选中当前节点。
clickToSelect.en-US: In multiple mode, clicking any node selects it. Often used with showNext set to hover: hovering expands the submenu and clicking selects the node.

showNext.zh-CN: 展开子菜单的时机：click 为点击，hover 为悬停。
showNext.en-US: When the submenu expands: on click or on hover.

loadData.zh-CN: 异步加载数据，参数为从根到当前节点的路径，需要返回 Promise；reject 后节点不再显示加载态，可以再次展开重试。不能与搜索同时使用。保留为函数 prop，因为需要读取返回的 Promise。
loadData.en-US: Loads data asynchronously. It receives the path from the root to the current node and must return a Promise; after a rejection the node leaves the loading state and can be expanded again. Cannot be used with search. It remains a function prop because the returned Promise is read.

filterTreeNode.zh-CN: 是否开启搜索：true 时按 treeNodeFilterProp 对应的属性值匹配输入，不区分大小写；也可以传入自定义的匹配函数。保留为函数 prop，因为需要读取返回值。
filterTreeNode.en-US: Whether search is on. True matches the input against the field named by treeNodeFilterProp, case-insensitively; a custom match function can be given instead. It remains a function prop because its result is read.

filterSorter.zh-CN: 对筛选后的结果排序，参数为两条结果路径（从根节点到匹配节点的节点数组）与输入内容。保留为函数 prop，因为需要读取返回值。
filterSorter.en-US: Sorts the filtered results; it receives the two result paths (the node arrays from the root to the matched node) and the input. It remains a function prop because its result is read.

filterLeafOnly.zh-CN: 搜索结果是否只展示叶子节点的路径。
filterLeafOnly.en-US: Whether the search results only show the paths of leaf nodes.

treeNodeFilterProp.zh-CN: 搜索时用于匹配输入的节点属性，默认 label。
treeNodeFilterProp.en-US: The node field matched against the search input, label by default.

remote.zh-CN: 是否开启远程搜索。开启后输入不再做本地过滤，只触发 search 事件，由使用方异步更新 treeData。
remote.en-US: Whether to search remotely. Input is then not filtered locally and only emits the search event, and the caller updates treeData asynchronously.

displayProp.zh-CN: 回填选项和标签显示的节点属性，默认 label。
displayProp.en-US: The node field shown in the trigger and the tags, label by default.

separator.zh-CN: 分隔符，用于搜索结果和单选回填到触发器的路径。
separator.en-US: The separator of a path in the search results and in the trigger in single mode.

changeWithObject.zh-CN: 是否让 change 事件携带每个节点的数据而不是它的 value。开启后受控的 modelValue 与 defaultValue 也要传节点数据，并含有 value。这是布尔属性，不是事件，不要写成 @changeWithObject。
changeWithObject.en-US: Whether the change event carries the data of each node instead of its value. A controlled modelValue and defaultValue must then be node data too, with a value. This is a boolean attribute, not an event: do not write it as @changeWithObject.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 搜索框的占位文字，不传时使用 placeholder。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search input; placeholder is used when it is not given.

searchPosition.zh-CN: 搜索框的位置：trigger 在触发器内，custom 由使用方自定义，此时用 search 方法传入搜索词。
searchPosition.en-US: Where the search input is: trigger puts it in the trigger, custom leaves it to the caller, who passes the keyword with the search method.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用。禁用后不可 Tab 到达。
disabled.en-US: Whether the Cascader is disabled. A disabled Cascader cannot be reached with Tab.

borderless.en-US: Whether to use the borderless style.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 触发器的校验状态，只影响样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status of the trigger; it only affects the style.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 内容的 id，用于关联 combobox 的名称；不传时在使用 insetLabel 插槽时由组件生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the insetLabel content, used to name the combobox; the component generates one when the insetLabel slot is used and this is not given.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 是否在挂载时展开下拉。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown is open on mount.

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启下拉的弹出动画。

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 下拉被边缘遮挡时是否自动调整展开方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown flips its direction when an edge covers it.

position.zh-CN: 下拉的展开方向，默认 bottomLeft，RTL 下为 bottomRight。
position.en-US: Direction of the dropdown, bottomLeft by default and bottomRight in RTL.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether clicks on the dropdown stop bubbling.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内的 focus 是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示获得焦点的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing inside the component stops the browser scrolling the document to show the focused element.

virtualizeInSearch.zh-CN: 搜索结果的虚拟列表配置，由 height、width、itemSize 组成，用于结果很多的场景；height 缺省为 180，与下拉框高度一致。
virtualizeInSearch.en-US: Virtual list configuration of the search results, made of height, width and itemSize, for large result sets; height defaults to 180, the same as the dropdown height.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 选中值变化时触发，是 v-model 的更新事件，载荷与 change 相同。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the selection changes; the update event of v-model, with the same payload as change.

change.zh-CN: 选中值变化时触发。单选为所选路径，多选为各选中路径的数组；开启 changeWithObject 时为节点数据。与原生 change 同名，声明后会遮住根元素上冒泡的同名原生事件。
change.en-US: Emitted when the selection changes. In single mode the selected path, in multiple mode an array of the selected paths; node data with changeWithObject. It shares its name with the native change and hides the native one that bubbles from inside the root.

select.zh-CN: 选中某个节点时触发，载荷是该节点的 value；多选时只勾选了一个节点时是它的 value，勾选多个时是 value 数组。
select.en-US: Emitted when a node is selected, with the value of the node. In multiple mode, one checked node gives its value and more give an array.

search.zh-CN: 搜索输入变化时触发，载荷是输入的文本。
search.en-US: Emitted when the search input changes, with the text.

focus.zh-CN: 点击或按键打开下拉时触发，载荷是那次 MouseEvent 或 KeyboardEvent。不是 DOM 焦点事件，Tab 进出不会触发。
focus.en-US: Emitted when a click or a key opens the dropdown, with that MouseEvent or KeyboardEvent. It is not a DOM focus event and Tabbing in or out does not emit it.

blur.zh-CN: 关闭下拉时触发：点击外部时载荷为 MouseEvent，Esc 为 KeyboardEvent，通过方法 close 关闭时为 undefined。不是 DOM 失焦事件。
blur.en-US: Emitted when the dropdown closes: a MouseEvent for a click outside, a KeyboardEvent for Esc, undefined when the close method closes it. It is not a DOM blur event.

dropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉展开或收起时触发，载荷是是否展开。
dropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Emitted when the dropdown opens or closes, with whether it is open.

clear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮清空选中值时触发。
clear.en-US: Emitted when the clear button clears the selection.

exceed.zh-CN: 多选时选中数量超出 max 时触发，载荷是已选节点的 Entity 数组。
exceed.en-US: Emitted in multiple mode when the selection goes past max, with the Entity array of the checked nodes.

load.zh-CN: 节点加载完毕时触发，载荷是已加载的 key 集合与该节点的数据。
load.en-US: Emitted when a node has loaded, with the set of loaded keys and the node data.

listScroll.zh-CN: 滚动列视图中的某一列时触发，载荷是滚动事件与该列的信息。搜索结果的滚动不触发。
listScroll.en-US: Emitted when a column of the tree scrolls, with the scroll event and the column. Scrolling the search results does not emit it.

keydown.zh-CN: 在 Cascader 处理按键之前触发，每次按键只触发一次；在其中调用 preventDefault 不会阻止 Cascader 的处理。除清除按钮与自定义触发器内控件上的按键外，事件在触发器的捕获阶段发出，此时调用 stopPropagation 会让搜索框收不到该键，并跳过触发器对它的处理（打开下拉、Esc 关闭），选项仍会处理该键。与原生 keydown 同名，会遮住根元素上冒泡的原生事件。
keydown.en-US: Emitted once per key press before the Cascader handles it; calling preventDefault there does not stop the Cascader. Except for a key on the clear button or a control inside a custom trigger, it is emitted in the capture phase on the trigger, so stopPropagation there keeps the key from the search input and skips the trigger's handling of it (opening the dropdown, closing it on Esc); the options still take it. It shares its name with the native keydown and hides the native one that bubbles from inside the root.

label.zh-CN: 列视图中选项的内容；搜索结果、回显和标签仍显示节点的文本。
label.en-US: Content of an option in the columns; the search results, the selection and the tags still show the text of the node.

display.zh-CN: 单选时已选路径的回显，参数为各级节点的 displayProp 与节点数据，值不在 treeData 中时 path 为原始值；内容为空时显示 placeholder。
display.en-US: The selected path shown in single mode, with the displayProp of each node and the nodes; path holds the raw values when the value is not in treeData. Empty content shows the placeholder.

tag.zh-CN: 多选时整体替换每个标签，onClose 取消该节点的选中。
tag.en-US: Replaces each tag in multiple mode; onClose unchecks the node.

filterItem.zh-CN: 替换搜索结果中的一行；只有一个元素根时，该元素自动获得选项的 id、role 与状态，否则组件包一层 li。
filterItem.en-US: Replaces a row of the search results. A single element root gets the id, role and state of the option, otherwise the component wraps it in an li.

trigger.en-US: Replaces the content of the trigger.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 自定义展开图标；内容为空时使用默认图标。
expandIcon.en-US: Custom expand icon; empty content keeps the default icon.

arrowIcon.zh-CN: 自定义右侧下拉箭头；空插槽隐藏箭头。有清除按钮可见时，悬停优先显示清除按钮。
arrowIcon.en-US: Custom dropdown arrow on the right; an empty slot hides the arrow. Hovering shows the clear button first when it is visible.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮的图标，showClear 为 true 时有效；内容为空时使用默认图标。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom icon of the clear button, effective when showClear is true; empty content keeps the default icon.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有可选数据或搜索无结果时展示的内容；未提供时显示语言包中的默认文案，空插槽隐藏空状态。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there is no data to pick or the search has no result. The default text from the locale shows when it is not given, and an empty slot hides the empty state.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 嵌在选择框内的标签；同时提供 prefix 时不渲染。
insetLabel.en-US: A label inside the select box; it is not rendered when prefix is also given.

topSlot.en-US: Extra content at the top of the dropdown.

bottomSlot.en-US: Extra content at the bottom of the dropdown.
